title: Project Overview
summary: Canonical entry point for the harness and its optional Local Mode. Contains the local-design quick start for OpenAI-compatible llama.cpp/LM Studio, validation commands, CLI examples, and routing to HUB.codex.md, local-model-guide.md, RUNBOOK.md, and SKILL.md. 型付き技法・被覆検証・非破壊移行はtechnique-coverage.mdを参照。 compact生成、予算・usage、証跡版の契約はefficient-generation.mdを参照。 batched生成・設計状態・比較再検証はspec-06とAC-20260910-batched.mdを参照。 要件定義信頼度・要確認集計・根拠付き再評価はrequirements-confidence.mdとspec-07を参照。
